Internally, this position is titled Senior Systems Development Engineer, but the closest market equivalent is an engineering-focused Senior SRE. This is a hands-on role where you own the architecture and design of complex distributed systems, but you remain deeply technical writing code and managing the underlying infrastructure.

The Technical Reality This is not a standard DevOps or Cloud Architect role. You will not just be writing Terraform modules, managing Kubernetes deployments, or building on top of managed commercial cloud services. You will be building the underlying cloud itself. The profile requires a true hybrid of two distinct halves:

  • Software Engineering: You will write robust, production-grade software from scratch (in Python, Go, Java, C++, or TypeScript) to build core control planes, self-healing workflows, and automation tooling.

  • Deep Systems/Linux Grit: You will own the health of the underlying infrastructure. You must be comfortable stepping away from high-level abstractions to troubleshoot at the bare-metal OS layer (diagnosing kernel panics, network latency, and memory management on Linux).

What You Will Be Doing
  • Architecting, designing, and deploying complex, highly available distributed systems at massive scale.

  • Writing high-quality code to fix bugs, automate manual toil, and deal with infrastructural components within large-scale systems.

  • Raising the engineering bar across the team through system design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring.

The Non-Negotiables
  • Citizenship: Due to strict federal security requirements, you absolutely must be an Australian Citizen and eligible to obtain a high-level Australian Government Security Clearance (AGSVA).

  • Location: This role requires working 5 days a week on-site in a highly secure Melbourne CBD office.

  • Experience & Mindset: Deep, demonstrable expertise in Linux/Unix systems engineering and operations, paired with strong professional software development capabilities (Python, Go, Java, etc.).

  • Architecture: Proven experience independently designing, building, and scaling complex distributed systems in production.

The Payoff (Why Make the Move?)
